dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: This wine really is better than tea at warming the gut and circulating the blood.

dialogues.speaker: Moli
dialogues.text: Wine, better than tea? Ha, I think you must have had too much to drink.

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: You just don't understand. Just a small cup of wine, and — ah! — it's like you've gone to heaven...

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: ...On the other hand, we have your Liyue tea. It's so bitter that it's hardly fit for human lips.

dialogues.speaker: Moli
dialogues.text: Heaven? Perhaps you're hallucinating. Why not try a trip to the Bubu Pharmacy?

dialogues.speaker: Moli
dialogues.text: The beauty of tea lies in the taste of sweetness that hides itself in the bitterness. Just like life, which has its ups and downs...

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: Oh, so a little drink of tea brings out the philosopher in you, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Moli
dialogues.text: And what of it? Tea is healthier than wine, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: Look at how yellow your teeth are from drinking tea all day. I don't see where the health comes from!
